name: smwmusic-touhou-kaikidan-mystic-square-the-fighting-dollmaker-the-grimoire-of-alice-remix
title: Touhou Kaikidan ~ Mystic Square - The Fighting Dollmaker ~ The Grimoire of Alice (Remix)
description:
Did a remix of The Grimoire of Alice from Touhou 5: Mystic Square. Should've done this a couple months back, but eh, it's done now. Great song and one of my favorites from the PC-98 era of Touhou games. Her PC-98 themes are 10x better than any of her themes in Touhou 7: Perfect Cherry Blossom. Fight me!

Important:
There are also 2 customizable pitches for this song that you can adjust in the song's txt file:
1. B Minor (Original Pitch, turned on default)
2. A Minor (Custom Pitch)
